notes: Phase 30 D PROOF-OF-PATTERN convergence study. Three gmsh C3D10 quadratic-tet mesh refinements (-clmax = 0.012/0.008/0.005 m). NOTE: gmsh only takes -clmax (upper bound) and the .geo file's Points fix the floor at cl=0.012; values larger than 0.012 produce identical meshes, so the lo refinement equals the canonical Phase 26 A mesh and the study refines FROM there. Each entry produced by a live ccx 2.23 + gmsh run (2026-05-18). Analytical reference is Euler-Bernoulli first natural frequency for a clamped-free uniform beam.
